items.quote: I've been told so many times that they just don't want to ask it because they just don't want to upset the client.
items.statement: Agents often avoid asking clients about their budget due to fear of upsetting them.

items.quote: you have to financially qualify him and help him understand if he's money, is he even able or what he needs to be able.
items.statement: Financial qualification of the client is necessary to understand their needs.

items.quote: we have to make him feel comfortable and build up with us the plan of how he's gonna make all of this money.
items.statement: Build comfort with the client before discussing financial matters.

items.quote: if you want to join online academy, it's on YouTube with all of the trainings, materials, scripts, call recording reviews.
items.statement: An online academy with training materials and resources is available for learning sales techniques.

items.quote: you start asking what the potentially comfortable monthly payments will be for you.
items.statement: Ask clients about their preferred payment structure to facilitate discussions about their budget.

overview: Video transcript discussing how to inquire about a client's budget while maintaining sensitivity to their feelings.
